title: Stage 1A Adversarial Assessment: Auto-Title Replacement, DeArrow Coexistence, Settings & TTS Bar Layout

findings.title: Async transcript/AI title generation race could overwrite late-arriving DeArrow title or disabled Settings state
findings.resolution: Added post-await invariant re-checks inside applyAiTitleToCard() for getAltTitlesEnabled(), isDeArrowPresent(), _userManualOriginal, and per-video altTitleInFlight request deduplication; verified via Check 42e in-flight async race test.

findings.title: Cross-tab alt_titles_enabled Settings changes could leave background tabs out of sync
findings.resolution: Registered GM_addValueChangeListener('alt_titles_enabled', ...) in setupCrossTabSync() to update .yt-alt-titles-setting-checkbox and immediately invoke refreshAllFeedCardTitles().

findings.title: Title mutation uses textContent via getTitleTextTarget() with _ytaisMutatingTitle re-entry guard
findings.resolution: Verified zero innerHTML injection surface in setCardTitleText() and safe MutationObserver loop suppression.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 1 Ask pipeline fault-injection & cross-window toast isolation, Stage 2 keyboard/ARIA hardening, and Stage 3 offline bundle export remain properly ordered and gated.

findings.title: isDeArrowPresent() checked global #dearrow-styles, window.dearrow, and .cbThumbnailButtonContainer, disabling AI replacement across all non-DeArrow feed cards
findings.resolution: Scoped isDeArrowPresent() strictly to the individual card/titleEl container and card-level attributes excluding .cbThumbnailButtonContainer; verified in Check 25 & Check 42a.

findings.title: getCardVideoId() regex limited video IDs to {8,15} chars, truncating longer IDs in DOM state and cache keys
findings.resolution: Expanded getCardVideoId() capture group to [?&]v=([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{8,32}) and verified across 371/371 E2E checks.

findings.title: Duplicate concurrent feed scans could launch duplicate Gemini title generation requests per video ID
findings.resolution: Added altTitleInFlight Map deduplicating in-flight generateAlternativeTitle() promises by videoId.

roadmapReview.notes: Expanded MutationObserver characterData + attributeFilter observation introduces negligible overhead due to debounced scan/card guards; Stage 1 per-window TTS toast scoping remains clean next step.

roleReviews.roleTitle: UX, Visual Layout & Spec Compliance Critic

findings.title: Default wide (~920px) floating window TTS bar overflowed right border and stacked speed preset buttons vertically
findings.resolution: Updated .yt-tts-control-bar to flex-wrap rounded-2xl max-w-full min-w-0 and kept .yt-tts-speed-btns nowrap on medium/wide tiers; verified 0 clipping in r2-tts-wide.png and compact 447px resize.

findings.title: Replacing inner text directly on <a id='video-title'> risked wiping nested <yt-formatted-string> nodes used by YouTube/DeArrow
findings.resolution: Added getTitleTextTarget() preserving nested <yt-formatted-string> / .yt-core-attributed-string elements cleanly; verified in Check 42b.

findings.title: Spec check: Auto-title enabled by default (true), turn-off option visible in both userscript Advanced panel and Simulator top/window settings, persists across reload, leaves DeArrow titles intact
findings.resolution: Verified end-to-end in live Chromium (cardsTextInitial -> cardsTextOff -> reload -> cardsTextRestored) and Check 42d.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 1–3 roadmap sequencing stays cohesive and preserves strict visual + functional acceptance gates.
